## Recap: 09:00 – 09:30

Bring your questions from yesterday. Specifically:

- Did your Quarto document render? If not, bring the error.
- Is your project structured with `data/`, `R/`, `output/`?
- Can you produce a boxplot of `gain` by `teaching_arm` from memory, with the
  cheatsheet open? Try before we start.

::: {.callout-important}
## Collect your group brief this morning
The [group activity brief](s10-group-activity.qmd) and starter `.qmd` are
handed out at the recap, **not** at 15:15. Your group has all day to think
about it; the 45-minute slot is for building, not deciding.

## The question that runs through today

> **How do I turn what I found yesterday into something a journal, a
> department or a funder will accept, without hand-copying a single number?**

## What "done" looks like by 17:00

Each group presents a rendered document containing:

- A Table 1 built with `gtsummary`
- At least one labelled figure
- At least one number reported through inline code
- A one-paragraph honest statement of limitations
- A sentence disclosing any AI assistance used

That is the shape of a real methods-and-results section, and you will have
built it in a day.
